signed_rows.behavior: With AGENTS.md and no CLAUDE.md, kmctl init adds the block to AGENTS.md and writes a CLAUDE.md holding only @AGENTS.md; with neither, it writes CLAUDE.md with the block. A CLAUDE.md that imports @AGENTS.md never gets the block, so a second init changes nothing.
signed_rows.fails_when: in a repository with only AGENTS.md, after init AGENTS.md lacks the block or loses any of its text, CLAUDE.md is missing, or CLAUDE.md holds anything but the @AGENTS.md line; or in an empty repository CLAUDE.md lacks the block; or a second init in the AGENTS.md-only case changes any file or adds the block to CLAUDE.md

signed_rows.behavior: A CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md symlink that is dangling or points outside the repository is left alone with a warning naming the link and its target; a dangling CLAUDE.md counts as existing, so no new CLAUDE.md is written; a link inside the repository is written through once. With an unsafe AGENTS.md link and no CLAUDE.md, init writes nothing and the warning says to fix the link.
signed_rows.fails_when: init creates or changes the target of a dangling link or of a link outside the repository, replaces such a link, writes a new CLAUDE.md beside a dangling one, gives no warning naming the link, or stops writing through CLAUDE.md -> AGENTS.md inside the repository; or with a dangling or outside AGENTS.md link and no CLAUDE.md, init writes a CLAUDE.md or gives no warning naming AGENTS.md

signed_rows.behavior: ADR 0011 has a dated Correction naming the @AGENTS.md case and the link rule, and init's help, the scaffold docstrings and docs/reference/commands.md say the same.
signed_rows.fails_when: ADR 0011 has no Correction naming @AGENTS.md, or the help, docstrings or reference still say only that init writes CLAUDE.md when neither file exists

signed_rows.behavior: The other init tests still pass.

resigns.reason: plan round 1 review and spike 1: CLAUDE.md imports AGENTS.md, a dangling link counts as existing, and the ADR, help and reference follow
plan round 2 review: an importing CLAUDE.md gets no block, and an unsafe AGENTS.md link writes nothing
